name: John Hartwell
summary:
John Hartwell (male).
Born ABOUT 1820 in Yorkshire, England.
Died 7 NOV 1891 in Cincinnati, Hamilton, Ohio, USA.
Occupation: Ironmonger.
Spouse(s): Mary Ashcombe, married 3 JUN 1846.
Notes: Emigrated to the United States in 1850 with his wife and eldest
son. Settled in Cincinnati, where he kept a hardware shopon Vine Street.
